explanation.interpretation: Feature value times the learned coefficient difference exactly reconstructs the target-versus-alternative logit margin, including the intercept. Contributions are not probability percentages.
limitations: Correlated word/character n-grams can share evidence.
A learned association is not proof of document type or real-world causation.
This explains the learned fallback only; any heading rules are held fixed.
